tasks.final_text: This is quite interesting. I would love to understand how this website works. And what is the goal. Are you trying to understand how and why people type things or something else. Awesome work, hope you can do some cool stuff with the information.

The National Museum of Galle (Galle National Museum) is one of the national museums of Sri Lanka. It is located in the oldest remaining Dutch building in the Galle fort, Galle, a single story colonnaded Dutch building built in 1656 as the commissariat store for the Dutch garrison at the fort.
